name: expediter-handoff
description: /handoff writes the expediter resume checkpoint and clears; guards /drive-tickets against push/merge, refreshes the checkpoint before compaction, and shows drive progress above the prompt.

auto_clear.title: Clear after /handoff
auto_clear.description: After /handoff writes the checkpoint, run /clear automatically. The expediter SessionStart hook then resumes from the checkpoint.

nudge_percent.title: Suggest /handoff at context %
nudge_percent.description: Show a toast once the context window passes this percent full.

guard_drive.title: Block push/merge during a drive
guard_drive.description: While a /drive-tickets checkpoint is not status: done, deny git push, git merge and gh pr merge (subagents included).

checkpoint_on_compact.title: Refresh checkpoint before compaction
checkpoint_on_compact.description: Before /compact or an auto-compaction, write a fresh checkpoint unless one was updated in the last 10 minutes.
